test_title: PYST 21: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 9th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

If he were / to climb the tree / and bring the kitty down, / the child was happy.
solution:
The correct answer is 'the child was happy', i.e. the error lies in this part of the sentence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points __**

__
 
• The error lies incorrect usage of past tense in a conditional sentence.
 
• The given sentence is an example of a second conditional sentence.
 
• **Second conditional sentence:** It talks about the **unreal possibility** of something happening in the future. It means that we are thinking about the future. We are thinking about a particular condition in the future and the result of this condition. But there is **not a real possibility** that this condition will happen.
 
• **Structure**:
 
 
• If+ past simple, would + base verb.
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• If I won the lottery, I would buy a scooter.
 
 
 
• ​Thus, 'would be' will be used in place of 'was'.

Correct sentence: __If he were to climb the tree and bring the kitty down, the child would be happy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Conditional sentence:** The word "condition" means "situation or circumstance". If a particular condition is true, then a particular result happens.
